scope.summary: Implement the SubD cage architecture in the solver body module per Section 13.16 (BK-16.5): the base mesh is a Catmull-Clark subdivision cage with per-level evaluation (view level vs bake level), plus an OPEN multi-resolution delta storage format (sparse per-level deltas, documented layout) as the REQ-037 foundation for HD detail — deliberately replacing Daz's proprietary gatekept .dhdm format with an openly authorable one.
acceptance_criteria: CatmullClarkCage evaluates the base cage to subdivision levels 0..=4 deterministically; limit positions at each level are reproducible bit-exact across runs on the same platform.
Evaluation supports independent view_level and bake_level settings; changing view_level never mutates stored authority data.
MultiResDeltas stores sparse per-level vertex deltas keyed by (level, vertex_id) in a documented versioned layout; serialize/deserialize round-trip is lossless.
A golden test pins that applying multi-res deltas then re-evaluating reproduces the authored surface within a stated epsilon.
No .dhdm parsing code exists in the crate (negative grep test) — the format is original.
scope.risk_if_missed: Without the cage/multi-res split, HD detail (pores, muscle striation, genital detail) has no open authoring lane and BodyKit inherits Daz's most-hated limitation: HD morphs locked behind a proprietary format nobody else can write.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.

required_changes_before_execution: Bind topology, masks, landmarks, UVs, weights, provenance, and decoupling to the accepted asset pack and feathered support-domain contract.
